notes.title: Update notes for update 0.3.0
notes.content:
Feature additions:
- Added an arena to Nivara with 5 new challenges to complete for orbs
    - Progress of arena challenges are preserved though planets
- Added unique behaviors to each different arena
    - Arcadia arena floods periodically, this water isn’t deep enough to drown Lena but slows her down
    - Nivara arena kicks up a blizzard that may freeze Lena in place for a time
- Added a small knock back effect to each weapon

Quality of life improvements:
- Graphical improvements to Arcadia

Bugfixes:
- Fixed Lena sometimes still being able to shoot while in cutscenes
- Fixed some walls on Nivara not having clear boundaries
- Fixed vendor items could still be clicked even if they were not visible
- Fixed issue where some enemies would just walk right through ammo crates
- Fixed an issue where Gravlock Launcher would shoot in a random direction if it had no target locked on
- Reduced footprint / drag opacity 
- Fixed Orb enemies on Voidwalker sometimes not being able to damage Lena.
- Fixed robot enemies rotating strangely on Voidwalker
- Fixed some saved state stability issues
- Better sync up attack animations with damaging Lena, adjust damage for enemies in accordance
- Fixed an issue where enemies right after second elevator on Voidwalker could follow Lena off platform if Lena died.
- Fixed bug where falling animation didn’t trigger while falling
- Fixed an issue where Nova Burst could explode prematurely if Lena was moving upwards while shooting.
- Various other small bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158063/14d1dede6b0a099b0986fd0dcb83d50e0da53ef6.png[/img]

[b]Feature Additions:
[/b]
- The chase continues with a new planet to explore, featuring:
    - New enemies
    - New weapons
    - New story
- Added new arena challenges to complete for additional orbs!

[b]Quality of life improvements:
[/b]
- Add weapon and tool number mapping on pause to ensure you can see which weapons you have as well as how to switch between them.
- Increase the contrast between the walls and floor on the Voidwalker ship
- Added a weapon vendor just before entering the arena to ensure you can have all the ammo you need before entering.
- Gave weapon xp slider a slight blue tint to make it easier to see
- Dying on the log or arena section on Arcadia will now send you back to that section, not back to your ship.

[b]Bugfixes:
[/b]
- Fix an issue where extra dialog bubble was visible upon leaving Arcadia on your ship
- Fix an issue where pausing the game again shortly after clicking resume could cause the pause UI to be unresponsive
- Be a little more forgiving for moving onto the edge of water and sinking in some situations on Arcadia
- Lower Pulverizer bullet contact volume by half

notes.title: Early access now available!
notes.content:
Lena is now available to play in early access!

This initial release includes:
- 2 planets (1 tutorial and 1 regular)
- 6 enemies
- 4 weapons
- 1 tool
- Story and npc dialog
- Platforming
- Puzzles
- Combat

As always, bug reports and suggestions are always appreciated in the forums.

I hope you all enjoy!
